Game.title: Game
Game.description: An Algebra 1 or OST review game card displayed in the Heights Algebra 1 Arcade.

title.description: Display title of the Algebra 1 review game.

description.description: Short student-facing summary of what the game practices.

enum: Data Analysis (Box Whisker, Line of Best Fit, Data, etc...)
Creating, Solving, Modeling Systems of Equations

reviewType.description: Whether the game is dedicated OST exam prep or unit topic review.

gameUrl.description: Teacher-provided link to launch the game.

thumbnailData.description: Uploaded image data URL or bundled local asset path (no external internet links).

published.description: Whether the game is visible to students in the public arcade.

featured.description: Whether the game is highlighted at the top of the arcade.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the teacher who added the game.

createdByName.description: Teacher display label (e.g., Mr. Baker, Mr. Tokar).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the game was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the game was last updated.

AuthorizedTeacher.title: AuthorizedTeacher
AuthorizedTeacher.description: Teacher account authorized to publish, edit, and remove games in the Heights Algebra 1 Arcade.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the teacher.

addedByUid.description: UID of the admin who added this teacher.
